high_level_description: This image is a scene from the movie "Days of Thunder" (1990), directed by Tony Scott. The setting appears to be a racetrack during a race or practice session. The background shows a large crowd of spectators in the stands, indicating that this is a public event. In the foreground, there is a man wearing a black racing suit with yellow stripes down the sides. The suit prominently displays the "Mello Yello" logo in bold red and yellow letters across the chest. He is holding a black helmet in his right hand, suggesting he is either a driver preparing for a race or has just finished one
